title: 6 Things a Godly Man Judges in Himself That He Lets Go in You
caption:
6 things a godly man judges in himself that he lets go in you.

The late excuse. The sharp tone. The corner almost cut. He runs the strict court on his own file and the generous one on yours, on purpose.

Why do you look at the speck in your brother's eye and pay no attention to the log in your own? (Matthew 7:3). Handle your log first. Then you can talk about anyone's speck.

Send this to the guy who's harder on everyone but himself.

#faith #humility #christianmen #manofgod #scripture #character #grace
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
